stage: Stage 6.2C.3 — TC-02 Non-Execution Diagnosis & Engineering Review

verified_corrections.issue: Premature AssertionError in execute_tc02.py suppressed execution trace and failure details.
verified_corrections.resolution: Raw stdout and stderr are now unconditionally persisted immediately after subprocess execution to scripts/tc02_raw_stdout.log and scripts/tc02_raw_stderr.log. Any JSON output is parsed and saved to scripts/tc02_execution_result.json prior to evaluating the exit code. If exit code is non-zero, a structured failure diagnosis is written to scripts/tc02_execution_failure_diagnosis.json and the script terminates cleanly without crashing.

verified_corrections.issue: n8n default expression sandbox blocks $env access in Ollama Query Embedder (ExpressionError: access to env vars denied).
verified_corrections.resolution: Added '-e N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false' to the docker exec command subprocess. This permits node expressions (Ollama Query Embedder and Ollama Grounded Generator) to resolve $env.OLLAMA_BASE_URL and model names without error.
verified_corrections.scoping: Exclusively scoped to the docker exec subshell process. The daemon container (genx-n8n), docker-compose.yml, and environment files remain completely unmodified.

execution_safety_assessment.retry_behavior: Strictly single-shot; no automatic retries or loops exist in runner.

remaining_risks.risk: Ollama CPU inference latency on host machine (Windows 11 with 8 GB RAM).
remaining_risks.mitigation: HTTP node timeouts are set to 60s for embedding and 90s for LLM generation; runner subprocess allows up to 180s before timeout.

remaining_risks.risk: Similarity score boundary for TC-02 query.
remaining_risks.mitigation: Hard thresholds (Framework >= 0.70, Voice >= 0.65) are enforced directly inside PostgreSQL SQL queries. If similarity is below 0.70, the workflow deterministically returns zero results rather than hallucinating.
